extraction.name: LongVid
extraction.description: A large-scale dataset of real-world long videos containing 300,000 hours of videos and 2 billion words of textual annotations, designed for training multimodal large language models on long-context video understanding.
extraction.creator: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhan Zhu, Haian Huang, Jianfei Gao, Kunchang Li, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Limin Wang
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation. The dataset is used for training video MLLMs with multi-stage short-to-long learning scheme, including video captioning, event relationship recognition, and temporal grounding tasks.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For event relation recognition task, captions of short videos are serially put in a medium-level video segment as ground-truth event relationship. For temporal grounding task, short video captions with corresponding timestamps are used as ground-truth, with randomly selected other timestamps in the current medium video segments as false options. Dense captions are formed by concatenating captions from lower levels.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Videos are processed at different resolutions (224×8 to 224×512 frames) with token compression to 16 tokens per frame. Data includes hierarchical captions from Ego4DHcap for short, medium, and long video segments. Training data utilizes instruction data annotated with GPT4-o from previous works including ShareGPT4o, VideoChatGPT-Plus, LLaVA-Video-178K and LLava-Hound, along with long video instruction data from MovieChat, Vript and LongVid.

rai:dataManipulationProtocol.evidence: For the event relation recognition task, models are required to choose the right order of an event sequence. Since we find the captions of short videos are highly concise and event-oriented, we use them as the event labels and serially put the short captions in a medium-level video segment as the ground-truth event relationship. For the temporal grounding task, we use the short video captions with the corresponding timestamps as the ground-truth, and randomly select other timestamps in the current medium video segments as the false options. For the dense caption task, we concatenate captions in the lower level to form a dense one.
